definitions.explanation: Payment made to an author, composer, or other creator based on the sales of their work, typically calculated as a percentage of sales.

examples.english: The royalty for this book is 10% of sales.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{印税|いんぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The author makes a living from royalties.

examples.japanese: {印税|いんぜい}⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: {印税|いんぜい} literally means "stamp tax" - {印|いん} refers to the stamp or seal verifying each printed copy, and ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ means tax. Historically, authors received payment based on the number of copies stamped.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{印税|いんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to receive royalties)
・{印税|いんぜい}⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧ (royalty income)
・{印税|いんぜい}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (royalty agreement)
・{印税|いんぜい}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (royalty rate)

TYPICAL RATES: In Japan, typical book royalty rates range from 5-15% of the cover price, with 10% being common for established authors.

OTHER TYPES OF ROYALTIES:
・⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ - copyright fee
・⟦ロイヤリティ→ロイヤリティ：29637_roiyariti⟧/ロイヤルティ - royalty (loanword, used for licensing, franchises)
・⟦{使用料|しようりょう}→使用料：29636_shiyouryou⟧ - usage fee
